Overview

Al Khor is a city in Al Khor with a population of 200,000. A coastal city north of Doha, known for its historic pearl diving heritage, mangrove forests, and the Al Bayt Stadium. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 330 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
